triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER source_pending_finalized AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON aos_capacity_publication_private.source_pending DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION aos_capacity_publication_private.require_pending_source_finalized()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aos_capacity_publication_private.require_pending_source_finalized()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "aos.org_id" TO 'org-org'
 SET "aos.project_id" TO 'dev-project'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM aos_capacity_publication_private.source_pending p
   WHERE (p.org_id,p.project_id,p.maker,p.attempt_key)=(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.maker,NEW.attempt_key)
    AND NOT p.finalized) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPACITY_SOURCE_PENDING_NOT_FINALIZED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
